name: Yamaha WR250R
intro: A high-revving dual-sport single. Most 2008-2015 bikes needed the stator recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2008-2015 WR250Rs were in recall 15V410 for the stator. The new stator has a white core. Some 2014-2016 bikes also had a clutch recall (16V800).
A-002.reason: The old stator can short out and kill the charging system. Repairs are free.

recalls.what: Stator coil insulation can fail and short out.
recalls.fix: Dealer fits a new stator free (white core).
